rejected_rule.statement: The rules of appropriation under the Roman-Dutch law do not apply to a judgment-debt once a decree has been entered.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "I therefore think that that argument of Mr. Rajapakse is unconvincing. The code provides for the execution of decrees and for their satisfaction. ... I therefore agree with my brother that the rules of appropriation under the Roman-Dutch law do not apply to the case of a judgment-debt."
